spot.why: Frame spans x 6280-7360, y 3200-5120. Left: 200 px to the current ad (right edge x 6080). Above: 2120 px to 'v2 / 01 Cover - B' (30:13736, bottom y 1080). Right and below: nothing on the page. Checked against every top-level node on Page 1. x 6480 gives 400 px if more air is wanted, and x 7560 is clear for a second variant. Note that 30:14651 and 30:14989 are one node (the ad and its Motion timeline id): same subtree, and the REST document id is 30:14989. Do not treat it as a duplicate, and never touch either id.

critique:
The current ad (30:14651, alias 30:14989; 12.0 s, 30 fps, 4 stacked scene frames, 23 animated layers) is a well-mannered Figma prototype that fades things in. Its vocabulary is right: line-mask reveals, expo-out arrivals, ease-in exits, one trim path. But one move ('opacity + 20-160 px slide') is used on 15 of 23 layers, and the scenes are cut as a slideshow: build in, freeze, push off to nothing, build in again. The layouts are lifted from the e-commerce page (hero card, 3-up product grid, pill price).

Measured failures:
(1) Frames 0-4 are a completely blank cream frame (luma 230 flat), and nothing moves until 0.30 s. The hook (headline readable, photo opaque) lands only at about 1.0-1.2 s.
(2) Brand 'Moku' first appears at 9.1 s, so the brand-by-2 s rule fails.
(3) freezedetect finds about 3.2 s of frozen frames: 0-0.30, 4.90-5.37, 7.43-8.50, 10.37-11.07 and 11.40-12.03. Camera pushes ease to a stop, and there is no parallax.
(4) Transitions are not designed. At 2.95-3.2 s the Scene 2 photo slides over Scene 1 while it is still visible. At 5.80-5.93 s a push-off leaves an empty frame. At 8.8-8.95 s a flat dark panel wipes an already-emptied frame. There is no match cut, no stacked colour wipe and no blur on moves peaking at about 280, 300 and 410 px per frame.
(5) Type moves as whole lines (the Scene 3 title is one block). There is no per-word stagger, scale punch or tracking.
(6) Staggers are 0.15 s (4.5 frames), and many keys sit on half frames (0.05 s grid). Hits follow no BPM.
(7) The price pill is visible as a 0.2-scale blob for about 4 frames. Two spring pops are used, the second with a rotation wobble on centred text.
(8) Scene 3 puts about 33 words on screen for 0.9-1.8 s, so read times fail. The details line gets 1.15 s against the 1.5 s needed.
(9) The logo fades in on black (grey for about 6 frames). The CTA is fully visible only 1.63 s, so the CTA rule (2 s or more) fails. The 6 % CTA pulse is barely perceptible.

Passing: palette, two typefaces, safe zones and margins, a clean last frame.
Keep: line masks (extend them per word), the curve set, the terracotta-on-cream look with the dark end card, the underline trim path.

Image notes: 13 unique hashes. All originals are 1400 px wide, so only #3 (90925717), #11 (acbb852e), #13 (b6f9ac8e), #5 (bff7b99e) and #8 (6abdd71a) fill 9:16 at about native resolution. #7 (hands, e6467ef2) and #12 (terracotta bowl, 5992035e) are the story and match-cut images; use them in masks or bands.

Trap: figma_export_node renders 1x1 px for any layer under an opacity-0 resting ancestor. The ad tiles were therefore cropped from the video at 8.0 s.
